findings.observation: Apple Bash3 with nounset treats expansion of an empty feature_args array as unbound. The first software build stopped during metadata setup, before invoking cargo build.
findings.resolution: Represent the software configuration with the explicit empty Cargo feature argument --features empty-string. Both arrays then have two elements; the hardware value alone differs.

findings.observation: With the unchanged probe manifest, CLI dependency-feature selection resolved asm in metadata but did not retain sha2-asm in Cargo.lock. Locked resolution rejected an explicitly expanded lock, and unlocked resolution removed that expansion.
findings.resolution: Parent approved a default-off probe feature alias hardware-sha256 forwarding to spiralcore-transfer/hardware-sha256. Cargo then generated and retained exactly the expected optional package/edge, with no existing dependency drift.

findings.observation: Apple ar accepts neither --version nor -V; both read-only attempts returned usage text.
findings.resolution: Record configured and xcrun-selected executable paths and SHA256 values, plus the Apple Command Line Tools package version. Clang's actual version output is recorded.
